chunks: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
'A white rooster with a split crest guards the dwelling of its inhabitants and seven dwellings around it.'

key_terms.دِيكٌ أَبْيَضُ أَفْرَقُ: a white rooster with a split/divided crest — a specific type of rooster believed to have spiritual protective properties

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about white roosters protecting homes?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through Imam al-Baqir (AS) from the Prophet (SAWAS), describes the spiritual and protective qualities of a white rooster with a split crest. In early Islamic and pre-Islamic Arabian culture, roosters were believed to possess the ability to perceive spiritual entities and ward off harm. The Prophet's statement frames keeping such a rooster as a means of communal protection extending to seven neighboring homes, reflecting a broader Islamic ethic of communal welfare and the spiritual significance found in certain animals.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said:
‘A white frightening rooster protects a house of its inhabitants, and seven other houses around it’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn Ali from abu Jamilah from Jabir who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
has said, ‘A white rooster which is called afraq (white) protects the house of its people and seven other houses around it.’”
